name: maybe_Script_SceneActiveObjectCheck

evidence: Only callees are 0x6F229C (701-caller script/global context accessor) and 0x632F80, disassembled as: ldr r0,[r0,#0x10c]; cmp r0,#0; ldrbne r0,[r0,#0x94]; moveq/movne 0/1. No callers, 36 bytes.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlayEffectAndSound
signature: void maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlayEffectAndSound(int self, u32 effect_handle, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)
summary: Plays the gimmick object's attached effect/sound at its own position: if the field scene has an effect manager (scene->f_e8) it triggers it with self+0xC0, then submits self->f_28/f_2c/f_30 as a position through 0x2140E8.
evidence: Calls 0x3D55F4(scene+0xe8,&self->f_c0) after 0x6497AC, and 0x2140E8(scene,self->f_28,self->f_2c,self->f_30). 0x3D55F4 initialises the scene sub-list at +0x1a0 (0x212F18); 0x2140E8 takes three consecutive floats from the object (x,y,z).

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_ReleaseEffect
signature: void maybe_Field_Gimmick_ReleaseEffect(int self, u32 unused1, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)
summary: Releases the effect instance stored on the gimmick (self+0xEC) back to the scene effect manager (scene->f_e8) via 0x3D55F4.
evidence: Identical structure to 0x5D8460 but passes arg1+0xec instead of self+0xc0; calls 0x6497AC then 0x3D55F4(scene->f_e8, arg1+0xec). No position submission.

name: Field_Gimmick_UpdateActionState
signature: u32 Field_Gimmick_UpdateActionState(int self, int threshold, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)
summary: Advances the gimmick's action state machine: if the scene is active it requests state 2 when the 0x669210 flag on self+0xEC is set, otherwise state 3 once the counter self+0x118 is below the incoming value.
evidence: Calls 0x633070 (scene-active predicate), then 0x669210&self->f_ec test and self->f_118 < arg2, and finally 0x006D3024(&self->f_34,2/3). 0x6D3024 is the state-transition method (vtable slot at +0x14, max state 4) of the 0x18-byte scheduler embedded at self+0x34.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdateActionStateByCount
signature: u32 maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdateActionStateByCount(int self, int compare_value, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)
summary: Same action-state advance as 0x5D84F8 but compares self->f_118 with the incoming value and only requests state 3 while self->f_118 - value is negative.
evidence: Calls 0x633070 for the active scene, then computes self->f_118 - arg2 and calls 0x006D3024(&arg1->f_34,3) on borrow. No other work, returns 1.

name: Field_Gimmick_PlayReactionAnim
signature: u32 Field_Gimmick_PlayReactionAnim(int self, int event_id, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)
summary: When an event id greater than 0x1D is received and the scene is active, fetches the gimmick's actor from handle self->f_14 and plays animation 7 in loop mode.
evidence: Guard `0x1d < arg2`, then 0x32D27C(self->f_14) (handle->actor) and 0x005E7848(actor,7,1); 0x5E7848 disassembles to `ldr r0,[r0,#0x60]; b 0x2A891C` i.e. actor animation controller play. Returns 0 (event consumed).

name: Field_Gimmick_SendEventType6
summary: Builds a 0x28-byte event record and, when the gimmick is in state 2, fills it with the linked object's id (object->f_8e resolved through 0x63E54C) and queues it as event type 6 on the scene queue at scene->f_e8.
evidence: State test self->f_38==2; 0x5E5410 clears the 0x28-byte record; the handle is decoded with the 0x1ffffff generation mask (g_5d9c64) and table g_5d9c68; 0x63E54C(obj, byte@+0x8e) result +0x1c goes into record+2; record[0]=2 and record+0x20=6; 0x3D5648(scene->f_e8,record) submits.

name: Field_Gimmick_SendEventForIdRange
summary: State-0x0F handler that classifies the gimmick's 16-bit id self->f_1a into two hard-coded ranges (0xAA3-0xB3A and 0xA82-0xAA2) and sends event type 0xE or 0xD with that id; every other id is submitted through 0x3D562C.
evidence: Compares local id obtained from 0x61BD4C(self->f_1a) against 0xaa3+0x98 and 0xa82+0x21, sets record type 0xe/0xd and calls 0x63339C(scene,record); the default path calls 0x3D562C. For states >0x0F it drives the +0x2c state machine (0x6D334C) to state 2/3.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_StopStateMachine
summary: Stops the gimmick's embedded action controller by invoking virtual slot 0x1C with 0 on the object hanging off the global context.
evidence: Only call is 0x6F229C then `(*(*ctx+0x14)+0x10)[0x1c](...,0)`. Identical body to 0x5DF260 and 0x5DB228; no caller, so only the calling convention is known.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SetStateMachinePair
summary: Calls virtual slot 0x28 on the global context object with (0,2), the two-channel variant of the gimmick state controller.
evidence: 0x6F229C -> ctx+0x14+0x10 -> vtable+0x28(...,0,2). Same 60-byte shape as 0x5D9EE0 which uses slot 0x1C.

name: Field_Gimmick_SendEventType3
summary: State-0x1E handler: emits event type 3 carrying the gimmick id self->f_1a, and for later states pushes the +0x2C state machine to state 3 once the scene is active.
evidence: self->f_38==0x1e branch sets record[0]=3 and record id self->f_1a then calls 0x63339C; else for >0x1e calls 0x632F9C/0x633070 and 0x6D334C(&self->f_2c,3).

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_EndActionWhenDone
signature: u32 maybe_Field_Gimmick_EndActionWhenDone(int self, int event_id, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)
summary: After event id 0x24 the gimmick asks its sub-controller at self+0x90 to change to state 3 and immediately finishes it when it reports completion.
evidence: Guard `0x24 < arg2` plus 0x633070; then `(*(arg1+0x90))[0x14](arg1+0x90,3)` (state query/transition) and `[0x10]()` (finish). Returns 1.

name: Field_Gimmick_UpdateEffectSlots
summary: Per-frame update of the three effect tracks at self+0x1C4: advances each track's timer by dt (self->f_a0), dispatches its 0x18-byte state callback, and when a track becomes active attaches the referenced object through 0x6427B0 and queues a scene event.
evidence: Loop i=0..2 reading self+0x1c4+i*4; track fields f_14+=f_a0, f_18++, state index f_10<4 selects entry at +0xc+i*0x18 with callback at +0x34; handle decoded with 0x7ff/0x1ffffff (g_5db008), 0x5E5410+0x6427B0 attach, 0x3D5610 queues. Identical handle/event idiom as the other gimmick handlers.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_ApplyPartTint
summary: Applies a colour/scale descriptor to every model part of the gimmick: builds a 0x3C-byte record (format string "$%x", name "Nut", value 1.0, RGB vector) and calls 0x4A3174 on the model handle self->f_44.
evidence: Literal pool at 0x5DB20C/210/214/218 gives "$%x" and 1.0f; 0x4A3174(self->f_44,0,&rec) applies the 0x38-byte descriptor to each of actor->f_1460 parts (0x4A2124 per part). 0x3D55F4 releases the effect at +0xad8 when self->f_b00 is set.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_StopStateMachineB
summary: Second two-instruction wrapper that stops the global gimmick controller (virtual slot 0x1C with 0).
evidence: Same decompiled body as 0x5D9EE0/0x5DF260; only callee 0x6F229C. Kept separate because the address is referenced from a different callback table slot.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_CopyPartAppearance
signature: u32 maybe_Field_Gimmick_CopyPartAppearance(int self, u32 unused1, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SendOpenedEvent
summary: Builds the 'object opened' event: id 0x413 becomes type 3, otherwise type 2 with self->f_d0 as item id (or type 4 when the flag self->f_d2 is set), then queues it through 0x3D5648.
evidence: self->f_d0 compared with 0x413; record[0]=2 with record+2=self->f_d0; 0x5E5410 init, 0x3D5648 submit. The 0x413 special case matches the treasure/quest item id used in the equipment code around 0x617FB0.

name: Field_Gimmick_UpdatePickupFlow
signature: u8 Field_Gimmick_UpdatePickupFlow(int self, u32 unused1, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_IsEventInputReady

name: Field_Gimmick_SendSlotEvent
summary: Chooses between the two stored targets self->f_d7/self->f_d8 (falling back to f_d4) and queues a type-2 or type-4 event with the chosen id; also latches the f_d9/f_da progress flags used by 0x5DD560.

summary: Continuation of 0x5DD488: on event id>=0x10 queues the pending target once (f_da latch), and after id 0x20 asks the +0x2C state machine to move to state 3 or returns 0 while the gimmick is disabled.
evidence: Two-stage `arg2 < 0x10` / `arg2 < 0x20` guards, f_d9/f_da state, 0x3D5610 submit, then 0x6D39B4(&self->f_2c,3) or return 0 when self->f_20==0.

name: Field_Gimmick_SpawnLinkedEffect

name: Field_Gimmick_SendEventType1Or2

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_StopStateMachineC

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_CheckToggleState
signature: u8 maybe_Field_Gimmick_CheckToggleState(int self, u32 unused1, u32 unused2, u32 unused3)

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_ComputeTimerStep

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SpawnNamedEffect

name: Field_SceneNode_UpdateMapRecord

summary: Keeps a scene node in sync with its map placement record: looks the record up by self->f_70 and asks the record (virtual +0x0C) to reposition itself to the node's X/Y (self->f_98/f_9c+4.0).
evidence: Calls 0x5E73FC, compares self->f_70 with the 'invalid' sentinel g_005f2ea0+4, resolves via 0x17C8D8 Map_FindRecordById(scene->f_9c, self->f_70), and invokes vtable+0x0c with (self->f_98, self->f_9c+4.0). Float 4.0f at 0x5F2EA4.

name: Field_SceneNode_SyncChildInstances
summary: Syncs all child scene nodes: calls virtual +0x24 on each, then if the node's map id changed, resolves the record, computes two position vectors via 0x669EB8 and calls the record's vtable+8, finally delegating to 0x5F6384.
evidence: Walks the intrusive list self->f_1e4..f_1e0 calling (*node)[0x24]; uses Map_FindRecordById 0x17C8D8 with a lazily allocated 0x98-byte singleton (same 0x627308 idiom) and virtual +8 with two vectors; tail-calls 0x5F6384.

name: Field_SceneNode_UpdateAttachedEffectTransform

name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_AllocState

The callee names come from N_008/N_013 outputs.
